text:
Liam H: Heads-up  candidate Jordan Park onsite Wed 2026-09-08 09:00 PT for Research HW evaluation + interviews. Ops checklist: 1) visitor prereg + fingerprint kiosk for secure lab access at 13:45, 2) NDA signing at reception, 3) lactation room 11:30-12:00 (private), 4) loaner laptop with Ubuntu + USB-serial drivers, 5) soy-free vegetarian lunch, 6) AV + wired ethernet in Lab 2 for remote interviewer in Berlin at 17:00 CET (08:00 PT).

Sofia P: I can handle prereg and escort. Where should they check in?

Liam H: Main lobby, ask for "Redwood reception". Jordan will have passport and printed NDA. Please flag the visitor record for fingerprint required and NDA signed.

AccessControlBot: Visitor prereg link created: https://redwood/reception/prereg?ref=RV-6120. Pre-reg submitted. Temporary badge code RV-6120. Secure-lab access requires onsite fingerprinting at Security Kiosk prior to 13:30.

Recruiter Zoe: Jordan's email is jordan.park+candidate@example.com. I've told them to bring ID and to expect to sign an NDA at check-in.

FrontDeskBot: NDA form uploaded to #people-ops-uploads and linked on the prereg. Please ensure Jordan signs before entering Lab 2. Badge will be printed with "NDA" sticker.

IT Support: We have loaner-ubuntu-01 ready. Will image with Ubuntu 22.04 and install usb-serial + pyserial. Imaging ETA 07:30. DM candidate email for account and SSH key if needed.

Liam H: Sending email now. Jordan prefers no soy in food (allergy) and asked for a quiet lactation room at 11:30.

CateringTeam: Noted soy allergy and vegetarian preference. Ordering vegetarian boxed lunch marked "Jordan  soy-free". Also ordering separate plate for lab snack (soy-free). Confirmation emailed.

Facilities: Lactation room reserved: Room L1 11:15-12:00. We'll post privacy sign and provide a chair and small fridge. AV and wired Ethernet arranged for Lab 2 at 08:30.

AccessControlBot: Fingerprint kiosk instructions for visitor:```
1) At Security Desk, present passport and temporary badge.
2) Sign NDA on tablet.
3) Follow prompts on Fingerprint Kiosk: select "Guest" -> enter badge code RV-6120 -> scan index fingers twice.
4) Security will approve; then escort to Lab 2.
```

Sofia P: I'll be at main lobby at 08:50 to meet Jordan and help with NDA. :wave:

IT Support: Imaging finished 07:10. Username jordan.park+candidate@example.com created. USB-serial test ok. Loaner assigned: loaner-ubuntu-01. Will leave power adapter and a short USB-C serial cable in bag.

Liam H: Note: Lab 2 has a small PPE requirement (anti-static wrist strap)  Jordan will bring their own, but Security should have spares.

Facilities: Security spares confirmed. We'll stage a strap at Lab 2 bench.

Recruiter Zoe: Remote interviewer in Berlin (Anke) confirmed 17:00 CET. I've added Anke's Zoom to the Lab 2 event and included wired-ethernet instructions. Anke asked for a 5-min AV check at 16:50 CET (07:50 PT).

Liam H: Can someone confirm the AV check?

Facilities: AV tech will run check 07:40-07:55 PT. Added to calendar.

FrontDeskBot: Badge printed on arrival. Escort assigned: Sofia P. NDA status will be updated in the visitor record.

Sofia P: Met Jordan, NDA signed, fingerprinted at 09:20 (early) and security approved. Heading up to Lab 2 now.

IT Support: Quick note  if Jordan needs serial port access use /dev/ttyUSB0 and run:```bash
sudo chmod 666 /dev/ttyUSB0
python3 -m serial.tools.miniterm /dev/ttyUSB0 115200
```

Liam H: Thanks all  closing the loop. If anything changes reply here.

Recruiter Zoe: Candidate asked about travel receipts  reimbursement via expenses@redwood.com with code CAND-HW-2026. I'll DM details.

CateringTeam: Lunch delivered to Lab 2 at 11:25 labeled "Jordan  soy-free".

Facilities: Lactation room set with fridge and sign. AV check succeeded.

IT Support: Loaner-ubuntu-01 left on bench with adapter. Serial cable included. VPN credentials are on the sticky note in the bag.

Liam H: Perfect, thanks team.
